hook.en: Ipoh, Taiping and Kuala Lumpur grew from tin mines. Rubber trees from Brazil covered the hills. Schools taught in four languages. Western rule reshaped the land and its people.
hook.bm: Ipoh, Taiping dan Kuala Lumpur berkembang daripada lombong bijih timah. Pokok getah dari Brazil memenuhi bukit-bukau. Sekolah mengajar dalam empat bahasa. Pemerintahan Barat mengubah bentuk tanah air dan rakyatnya.

bigIdeas.en: Tin mining and rubber planting became the backbone of the colonial economy.
bigIdeas.bm: Perlombongan bijih timah dan penanaman getah menjadi tulang belakang ekonomi kolonial.

bigIdeas.en: Roads, railways and ports were built mainly to carry tin and rubber to the coast.
bigIdeas.bm: Jalan raya, landasan kereta api dan pelabuhan dibina terutamanya untuk membawa bijih timah dan getah ke pantai.

bigIdeas.en: Immigration of Chinese and Indian workers created a plural society; vernacular schools followed separate paths.
bigIdeas.bm: Kemasukan pekerja Cina dan India membentuk masyarakat majmuk; sekolah vernakular mengikut haluan masing-masing.

detail.en: Malay, Chinese, Tamil and English schools
detail.bm: Sekolah Melayu, Cina, Tamil dan Inggeris

detail.en: Ethnic groups linked to different jobs and places
detail.bm: Kaum dikaitkan dengan pekerjaan dan tempat berbeza

definition.en: A society of several ethnic groups living side by side.
definition.bm: Masyarakat yang terdiri daripada beberapa kaum yang hidup bersebelahan.

definition.en: School teaching in a community's own language (Malay, Chinese, Tamil).
definition.bm: Sekolah yang mengajar dalam bahasa ibunda sesuatu kaum (Melayu, Cina, Tamil).

definition.en: Modern commercial sector beside traditional rural farming.
definition.bm: Sektor komersial moden bersebelahan pertanian luar bandar tradisional.

definition.en: Recruitment of Indian estate workers through a foreman (kangani).
definition.bm: Pengambilan pekerja ladang India melalui seorang mandur (kangani).

question.en: Explain TWO social effects of British rule.
question.bm: Jelaskan DUA kesan sosial pemerintahan British.

steps.en: Plural society: immigrants from China and India settled, creating a multi-ethnic population.
steps.bm: Masyarakat majmuk: imigran dari China dan India menetap, membentuk penduduk berbilang kaum.

steps.en: Education: separate vernacular schools (Malay, Chinese, Tamil) and English schools developed.
steps.bm: Pendidikan: sekolah vernakular berasingan (Melayu, Cina, Tamil) dan sekolah Inggeris berkembang.

answer.en: Also accepted: growth of towns; ethnic groups linked to different occupations.
answer.bm: Juga diterima: perkembangan bandar; kaum dikaitkan dengan pekerjaan berbeza.

prompt.en: Which two products were the backbone of the colonial economy in Malaya?
prompt.bm: Dua hasil manakah menjadi tulang belakang ekonomi kolonial di Tanah Melayu?

explanation.en: Both were in great demand by industries in the West.
explanation.bm: Kedua-duanya sangat diperlukan oleh industri di Barat.

prompt.en: The first railway in Malaya (1885) linked…
prompt.bm: Landasan kereta api pertama di Tanah Melayu (1885) menghubungkan…

explanation.en: It carried tin from Larut to the coast.
explanation.bm: Ia membawa bijih timah dari Larut ke pantai.

prompt.en: Who promoted rubber planting and a better tapping method in Malaya?
prompt.bm: Siapakah yang mempromosi penanaman getah dan kaedah menoreh yang lebih baik di Tanah Melayu?

explanation.en: He was director of the Singapore Botanic Gardens.
explanation.bm: Beliau pengarah Taman Botani Singapura.

prompt.en: Most Chinese immigrants in the 19th century came to work in…
prompt.bm: Kebanyakan imigran Cina pada abad ke-19 datang bekerja di…

explanation.en: Many also became traders.
explanation.bm: Ramai juga menjadi peniaga.

prompt.en: Most Indian immigrants came to work in…
prompt.bm: Kebanyakan imigran India datang bekerja di…

explanation.en: Many were recruited through the kangani system.
explanation.bm: Ramai diambil melalui sistem kangani.

prompt.en: A society made up of several ethnic groups living side by side is a ______ society.
prompt.bm: Masyarakat yang terdiri daripada beberapa kaum yang hidup bersebelahan ialah masyarakat ______.

explanation.en: This is a lasting effect of colonial immigration.
explanation.bm: Ini kesan berkekalan imigrasi zaman kolonial.

prompt.en: The Malay College Kuala Kangsar (MCKK) was opened in…
prompt.bm: Maktab Melayu Kuala Kangsar (MCKK) dibuka pada…

explanation.en: It trained sons of Malay royalty and nobles for administrative posts.
explanation.bm: Ia melatih anak-anak raja dan pembesar Melayu untuk jawatan pentadbiran.

prompt.en: Which town grew rapidly because of tin mining in the Kinta Valley?
prompt.bm: Bandar manakah berkembang pesat kerana perlombongan bijih timah di Lembah Kinta?

explanation.en: Kuala Lumpur and Taiping also grew from tin.
explanation.bm: Kuala Lumpur dan Taiping juga berkembang kerana bijih timah.

prompt.en: Select ALL types of school that developed under British rule.
prompt.bm: Pilih SEMUA jenis sekolah yang berkembang di bawah pemerintahan British.

explanation.en: English schools also existed. A single national system came only after independence.
explanation.bm: Sekolah Inggeris juga wujud. Sistem kebangsaan tunggal hanya wujud selepas merdeka.

options.en: A single national school for all

prompt.en: Why were most roads and railways built on the west coast?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah kebanyakan jalan raya dan landasan kereta api dibina di pantai barat?

explanation.en: This caused uneven development between regions.
explanation.bm: Ini menyebabkan pembangunan tidak seimbang antara wilayah.

options.en: To carry tin and rubber from mines and estates to the ports
options.bm: Untuk membawa bijih timah dan getah dari lombong dan ladang ke pelabuhan

options.en: Because the east coast had no people

prompt.en: "Dual economy" under the British means…
prompt.bm: "Ekonomi dualisme" di bawah British bermaksud…

explanation.en: Many Malays stayed in traditional farming and fishing.
explanation.bm: Ramai orang Melayu kekal dalam pertanian dan perikanan tradisional.

options.en: a modern commercial sector beside a traditional rural sector
options.bm: sektor komersial moden bersebelahan sektor luar bandar tradisional

prompt.en: Match each economic activity with the group most involved during colonial times.
prompt.bm: Padankan kegiatan ekonomi dengan kaum yang paling terlibat semasa zaman kolonial.

explanation.en: This "divide by occupation" affected unity.
explanation.bm: Pembahagian mengikut pekerjaan ini menjejaskan perpaduan.

prompt.en: Indian estate workers were often recruited through the ______ system.
prompt.bm: Pekerja ladang India sering diambil melalui sistem ______.

explanation.en: A kangani (foreman) recruited workers from his home area in South India.
explanation.bm: Kangani (mandur) mengambil pekerja dari kawasan asalnya di India Selatan.

prompt.en: Which social effect created challenges for unity after independence?
prompt.bm: Kesan sosial manakah menimbulkan cabaran kepada perpaduan selepas merdeka?

explanation.en: National policies later tried to bring communities together.
explanation.bm: Dasar kebangsaan kemudian cuba menyatukan masyarakat.

options.en: Ethnic groups lived and worked separately with separate schools
options.bm: Kaum tinggal dan bekerja secara berasingan dengan sekolah berasingan

prompt.en: Arrange the path of tin from mine to world market under British rule.
prompt.bm: Susun perjalanan bijih timah dari lombong ke pasaran dunia di bawah British.

explanation.en: Infrastructure served the export economy.
explanation.bm: Infrastruktur memenuhi keperluan ekonomi eksport.

prompt.en: The Sultan Idris Training College (1922) mainly trained…
prompt.bm: Maktab Perguruan Sultan Idris (1922) terutamanya melatih…

explanation.en: It later produced many Malay nationalists.
explanation.bm: Ia kemudian melahirkan ramai nasionalis Melayu.

prompt.en: Why did British infrastructure benefit the colonial economy more than ordinary rural people?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah infrastruktur British lebih menguntungkan ekonomi kolonial berbanding penduduk luar bandar biasa?

explanation.en: The east coast and rural areas were left behind.
explanation.bm: Pantai timur dan kawasan luar bandar ketinggalan.

options.en: It linked mines and estates to ports, not most rural villages
options.bm: Ia menghubungkan lombong dan ladang dengan pelabuhan, bukan kebanyakan kampung luar bandar

options.en: It was built only in villages
It was free for farmers only

prompt.en: Why did the British give Malays mainly basic vernacular education?
prompt.bm: Mengapakah British memberi orang Melayu kebanyakannya pendidikan vernakular asas sahaja?

explanation.en: MCKK served the elite; most village schools taught basic literacy.
explanation.bm: MCKK untuk golongan elit; kebanyakan sekolah kampung mengajar asas membaca dan menulis.

options.en: To keep most Malays as farmers and fishermen while training a small elite for administration
options.bm: Untuk mengekalkan kebanyakan orang Melayu sebagai petani dan nelayan sambil melatih golongan elit kecil untuk pentadbiran

options.en: Because Malays did not want schools
options.bm: Kerana orang Melayu tidak mahu sekolah

options.en: To prepare all Malays for university
options.bm: Untuk menyediakan semua orang Melayu ke universiti

prompt.en: Which present-day Malaysian feature is a direct legacy of colonial economic policy?
prompt.bm: Ciri Malaysia masa kini manakah warisan langsung dasar ekonomi kolonial?

explanation.en: The plantation model began in the colonial period.
explanation.bm: Model perladangan bermula pada zaman kolonial.

options.en: Large plantation sectors such as rubber and oil palm
options.bm: Sektor perladangan besar seperti getah dan kelapa sawit

options.en: Islam as the religion of the Federation

prompt.en: What can Malaysians today learn from the colonial "divide by occupation" pattern?
prompt.bm: Apakah yang boleh dipelajari rakyat Malaysia daripada corak "pembahagian mengikut pekerjaan" zaman kolonial?

explanation.en: Separation can create misunderstanding; mixing builds trust.
explanation.bm: Pengasingan boleh menimbulkan salah faham; pergaulan membina kepercayaan.

options.en: Shared schools, workplaces and opportunities help build unity
options.bm: Sekolah, tempat kerja dan peluang yang dikongsi membantu membina perpaduan
